feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: Tennessee halts executions after woman survives lethal injection
entry.summary: Christa Gail Pike was sentenced to death for a 1995 murder and was supposed to be executed Wednesday night. But after two lethal injections, she was still alive.

entry.title: Israel's PM says a pilot tried to crash a plane traveling to Tel Aviv
entry.summary: One pilot stabbed another pilot on a flydubai flight headed to Tel Aviv on Wednesday and may have tried to crash the plane before passengers and crew members subdued him, Israel's prime minister says.

entry.title: After flydubai incident, a look at how pilots train to avert cockpit interference
entry.summary: NPR's A Martinez speaks with retired military and commercial airline pilot Ron Alvarado about how pilots are trained to avert interference in the cockpit.

entry.title: California gubernatorial candidates face off in debate
entry.summary: California's candidates for governor square off in a debate while the blue-leaning state grapples with affordability and other issues.

entry.title: Studying this super El Niño could save lives. NOAA is scaling back research
entry.summary: A powerful El Niño is already influencing extreme weather around the planet. During the last strong El Niño, federal agencies ramped up research in the hope of improving weather forecasts. This year, they won't be matching that effort.

entry.title: Egg prices have tumbled since Trump returned to office. Here's why
entry.summary: Agriculture experts say high egg prices were the result of severe avian flu outbreaks, but the Trump administration's tariffs and the war with Iran have also put pressure on farmers.

entry.title: Do AI and air traffic control mix? CEO addresses anxiety about new FAA tool
entry.summary: The FAA's ambitious overhaul of the air traffic control system comes amid rising public anxiety about AI. The CEO of the company that's building the software explains how it works.

entry.title: SNAP's funding model is starting to change. Here's what that means for the program
entry.summary: States will start to pay a larger share of the bill to run the food assistance program, as federal funding for operational costs shrinks.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: Israel's prime minister says a pilot may have tried to crash a plane traveling to Tel Aviv, Trump visits Oklahoma to campaign for GOP candidates, Pete Hegseth announces new military initiatives.

entry.title: The biggest divorce trial in British history is the center of HBO's new series, 'War'
entry.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with Dominic West, who plays a wealthy husband engaging in "the biggest divorce trial in British legal history" in the HBO series "War."
